notes: Primary product: post-call QA + coaching dashboard for enterprise CX teams.
Rationale: reduce QA review headcount by 40% via automated summaries + highlight reels.
Call profile: avg call 4m, transcripts ~1.5k-3k tokens; many 3rd-party telephony integrations (Twilio, Genesys).
Peak pattern: daily end-of-day spikes and monthly sales events — needs graceful degradation + predictable performance during spikes.
Latency expectations: near-real-time summary ingest (<30s post-call) for agent workflow; batch nightly QA scoring for full transcript.
Throughput target: supporting 20-30 concurrent calls/sec at peak, sustained bursts to 60 calls/sec for short windows.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for reserved capacity if unit economics predictable; wants optimize suggestions for quantization/batching.
Model preference: open to Llama-family quantized variants for cost, wants fallback to smaller low-cost models for non-critical summaries; pilot with high-quality supervised model for QA scoring.
Integration asks: tool-calling support for CRM screen-pop + automated ticket creation; function-calling to trigger case creation in Zendesk/Salesforce.
Security asks: audit logging per-token, retention controls by customer, ability to route EU traffic to EU region (data residency).
Quote from Head of CX: "We need summaries we can trust for coaching — precision > recall for QA flags. False positives are expensive."
Ops note: want canary rollout and easy rollback for new model versions; request for per-route latency cost dashboard in Console.
poC_scope: 7-day pilot: ingest 2k calls, compare Redwood summaries vs human QA; measure precision of QA flags, latency, and cost per call.
acceptance_criteria: 1) automated summaries >= 85% agreement with human highlights on sample set; 2) median post-call summary time < 30s; 3) predictable cost estimate for 6-month run.
technical_considerations: Need streaming transcript ingestion + finalization hooks; KV/prefix caching to reuse agent prompts; prefer VPC peering for transcript upload; fallback routing when dedicated pool saturated.
procurement_notes: Procurement requires SOW + data processing addendum; legal wants clause for EU data residency and encryption-at-rest key control.
sales_play: Position Redwood Dedicated + Optimize: reserved pool for peak, hosted API for burst overflow; emphasize rollout tools (canary/A-B) and per-token cost dashboards.
